name: steel helm
_design_note: F35-60 medium head slot. Segmented spangenhelm with hinged cheek guards. Material is the variation axis — name retained for canon.
lore_template: A segmented {material_name} spangenhelm with a riveted brow band and hinged cheek guards. The polished surface deflects glancing blows; the thoughtful ventilation keeps the head from cooking under load.
